items.sum: Actress Edin Rose will be seen doing her own action stunts without a body double in Rajinikanth's upcoming sequel, Jailer 2, directed by Nelson Dilipkumar. Her background in martial arts helped her prepare for the physically demanding sequences in the film.
items.hook: Edin Rose performs her own action stunts in Rajinikanth's Jailer 2

items.title: Baththa box office collection Day 7: Vijay Sethupathi film crosses Rs 14 crore
items.sum: Vijay Sethupathi's Baththa crossed a domestic net collection of Rs 14.04 crore in its first week. The Balaji Tharaneetharan directorial earned Rs 1.29 crore on its seventh day, according to Sacnilk. Co-producer Atlee stated plans to take the film to the Oscars.
items.hook: Vijay Sethupathi starrer Baththa crosses Rs 14 crore domestic box office

items.title: Shankar resumes work on Indian 3 with Kamal Haasan amid rumours of it being shelved after Indian 2's dismal box office performance | Hindustan Times
items.sum: Director Shankar has confirmed that Indian 3 has gone on floors, putting an end to shelving rumours following Indian 2's poor box office run. The upcoming prequel stars Kamal Haasan as Senapathy's father, Veerasekaran Balaram. While major portions were shot alongside the previous film, an official release date has not been announced.
items.hook: Shankar and Kamal Haasan officially resume work on Indian 3

Jailer 2 Eyes Rajinikanth's Widest Singapore Release, Can It Surpass Enthiran to Become the Highest-Grossing Tamil Film?
items.sum: Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 is reportedly slated for an October 15, 2026 release across 27 cinema locations in Singapore. Distributed by X Gen Studios, the Nelson Dilipkumar directorial has also reportedly secured IMAX screenings. The original Jailer grossed S$1.78 million in the region, while Enthiran holds the all-time record at S$2.50 million.
items.hook: Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 eyes massive Singapore release with IMAX screenings

Nana Patekar’s Tamil cinema journey – From Bommalattam to Kaala
items.sum: Actor Nana Patekar appeared in two Tamil films during his career, debuting in the 2008 murder mystery Bommalattam directed by Bharathiraja. Ten years later, he played the antagonist opposite Rajinikanth in the 2018 film Kaala, winning an Ananda Vikatan Cinema Award for his performance.
items.hook: Nana Patekar starred in two Tamil films, Bommalattam and Kaala

items.title: Mandaadi OTT Release: When and Where to Watch the Film Online?
items.sum: Soori's sports action drama Mandaadi is now streaming on Netflix starting October 8, 2026, following a theatrical release on September 10. The film grossed over 150 crore rupees worldwide during its box office run. Directed by Mathimaran Pugazhendhi, the multilingual release also features Suhas, Mahima Nambiar, and Sathyaraj.
items.hook: Soori starrer Mandaadi makes its OTT debut on Netflix

items.title: Mandaadi Now Streaming On OTT: Where To Watch Soori Starrer Sports Action Film Online
items.sum: Tamil sports action drama Mandaadi, starring Soori, Suhas and Mahima Nambiar, is now streaming on Netflix from October 8, 2026. Directed by Mathimaran Pugazhendhi and released in theatres on September 10, 2026, the film is available in five languages.
items.hook: Soori starrer sports action drama Mandaadi starts streaming on Netflix

items.title: Sivakarthikeyan Announces He Will Do Only Mass Commercial Films From Now; Shares Updates on 'Seyon' and 'SK27'
items.sum: At a Chennai event on Sunday, Sivakarthikeyan stated he will focus only on mass commercial films. He gave updates on Seyon, directed by Sivakumar Murugesan, noting 60 percent is complete. He also discussed SK27 with director Ramkumar Balakrishnan, which began shooting in September.
items.hook: Sivakarthikeyan says he will only do mass commercial films from now on

items.title: Indian 3 War Mode Posters Unveiled as Kamal Haasan's Film Eyes Pongal 2027 Release After Indian 2 Setback
items.sum: Lyca Productions has unveiled new posters for Kamal Haasan's Indian 3, officially titled Indian 3: War Mode. Industry buzz suggests a potential Pongal 2027 theatrical release, though the release date remains unconfirmed. This follows the disappointing box office run of Indian 2 in 2024, which grossed ₹148.90 crore worldwide.
items.hook: New posters for Kamal Haasan's Indian 3 War Mode released

items.title: Karthik Subbaraj’s Next Feature Starring Prabhu Deva, Atharvaa, and Upendra Headed Directly to Netflix
items.hook: Karthik Subbaraj directs Prabhu Deva, Atharvaa, and Upendra in a Netflix film
items.sum: Director Karthik Subbaraj revealed that his next untitled feature starring Prabhu Deva, Atharvaa, and Upendra will release directly on Netflix. The first schedule is complete, with the next one starting next month. The film is based on a novel adapted with elements of the Tamil folk art Puliyaattam.

items.hook: Kamal Haasan and Shankar film Indian 3 officially confirmed
items.sum: Makers confirm the third installment of the Indian franchise starring Kamal Haasan and directed by Shankar. Post-production has already begun for the film, which features Senapathy's father Veerasekaran Balram and a returning cast including Siddharth and Kajal Aggarwal.

items.title: Vijay has opened Tamil Nadu politics to a new breed of cinema heroes
items.hook: Vijay is reshaping Tamil Nadu politics and inspiring other cinema heroes
items.sum: TVK leader Vijay has influenced a shift in Tamil Nadu politics by launching a party and challenging traditional Dravidian parties like DMK and AIADMK. Following his path, other actors are also engaging in social welfare outreach. Meanwhile, political leaders and parties are watching the ground shift under them.
